frontend.evidence_inherited_from: DEPTH07; frontend bytes unchanged, no new browser or Node certification

vault_scope: Owner edits, conflict review, source fingerprint controls, permission revocation, deletion and export tested locally. No external OAuth connector or browser acceptance claimed.
flight_scope: 1–9 adults; per-leg server prices/taxes/refund fees, explicit distinct vault travelers, one simulated ticket per traveler per leg. Child/infant fares, partial-leg changes/refunds and protected connections remain unaccepted.
refund_scope: Whole-flight refund including captured change differences, original-capture allocation, durable pending claim and replay after partial failure. Local simulator only.
money_scope: Idempotency binds intent/type/amount/parent; released authorization cannot be captured; captured authorization cannot be released; SQLite concurrent refund budget tested. Six PostgreSQL tests remain skipped.

migrations.populated_downgrade: REFUSED; retain evidence or restore verified backup

rental_scope: CNY isolated fixed-day pricing, pickup/return reprice quote, amount consent, durable change/refund plans; repeated positive/negative changes and original remaining-capture refunds, partial failure recovery and SQLite concurrency tested. Supplier dynamic pricing, close-to-pickup penalties and deposit settlement remain unaccepted.
direct_hotel_scope: Official hosted reservation joins shared intent/root/source fact, AUTHORIZATION/CAPTURE/RELEASE/REFUND graph and balanced ledger. Actual dual-confirmed checked-out amount captured, unused authorization released, post-stay approved refunds bind original capture. Durable pending retry, owner case submission, independent approval budgets, case-isolated closure and GO Trips navigation tested in SQLite simulation. Full no-show/confirmed cancellation, dated extension/StayCredit and live PSP/bank settlement remain unaccepted.
acceptance_separation: Live provider evidence is a separate deployment obligation; its absence does not waive isolated engineering acceptance.
targeted_source: Extracted unchanged testcase records from this full_regression.xml

durable_execution.local_effect_semantics: Effect + checkpoint + evidence committed in one DB transaction per step and task identity
durable_execution.external_effect_semantics: No automatic resend after ambiguous outcome; receipt must bind original operation key
durable_execution.qualification_semantics: Persistent, expiring, independently validated; checked again before every step
durable_execution.c13_semantics: Deterministic admin-authorized observation; self-qualification remains prohibited
durable_execution.application_scope: Aggregate operational observations; no refunds, provider actions or release approvals executed
durable_execution.worker: Explicit standalone process; drains durable queue; no automatic periodic task producer
